body:
## Pull request overview

Fixes CI failures by updating code to match recent dependency/tooling expectations (notably `react-grid-layout` v2.x API changes) and resolving lint errors in `permissions` and `plugin-designer`.

**Changes:**
- Migrates `plugin-dashboard` grid layout to the `react-grid-layout@2.x` hook-based width measurement and new drag/resize config props.
- Resolves lint failures in `permissions` by removing unused imports and adjusting destructuring for `prefer-const`.
- Resolves `plugin-designer` lint issues by removing unused imports and avoiding state updates inside `useEffect`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 7 out of 7 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx | Migrates responsive grid usage away from `WidthProvider` to `useContainerWidth` + `width` prop; updates draggable/resizable props to new API. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/CollaborationProvider.tsx | Removes `useEffect` state updates; derives `users` via `useMemo` and computes `isConnected` directly. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/PageDesigner.tsx | Prefixes unused `setZoom` setter to satisfy lint. |
| packages/plugin-designer/src/ProcessDesigner.tsx | Removes unused `Plus` icon import. |
| packages/permissions/src/store.ts | Adjusts destructuring to satisfy `prefer-const` while preserving reassigned variables. |
| packages/permissions/src/usePermissions.ts | Removes unused `useCallback` import. |
| packages/permissions/src/useFieldPermissions.ts | Removes unused type import. |
</details>

`handleLayoutChange` relies on type assertions (`layout as ...`, `allLayouts as ...`) to force the new react-grid-layout callback types into the old `{ lg: LayoutItem[] }` shape. This defeats type-safety and risks runtime mismatches as `ResponsiveLayouts` may include multiple breakpoints. Consider updating `layouts` state to `ResponsiveLayouts` (and `onLayoutChange` to accept `Layout`/`LayoutItem[]`) so the callback can be typed without casts.
